senses.sense_definition: Of a medical therapy or treatment: applied after initial treatment to suppress secondary tumor formation or enhance overall effectiveness.

examples.text: The patient began <w>adjuvant</w> chemotherapy shortly after undergoing successful surgery to remove the primary tumor.
Doctors recommended <w>adjuvant</w> radiation therapy to reduce the risk of cancer recurrence.

senses.sense_definition: Enhancing the immune system's response to an antigen, or containing a substance that does so.

examples.text: The vaccine contains an <w>adjuvant</w> component designed to stimulate a stronger antibody response.
Researchers evaluated several <w>adjuvant</w> formulations to determine which provided the most durable protection.

senses.sense_definition: Providing assistance, support, or facilitation; helping.

examples.text: The committee established an <w>adjuvant</w> council to assist with ongoing administrative tasks.
Such <w>adjuvant</w> measures can facilitate recovery alongside standard lifestyle interventions.

senses.sense_definition: A substance added to a vaccine or other drug to increase or modulate the immune response to an antigen.

examples.text: Aluminum salts are commonly utilized as an <w>adjuvant</w> in many modern childhood vaccines.
Without an effective <w>adjuvant</w>, the protein alone failed to produce a protective immune response.

senses.sense_definition: A secondary treatment or therapy given to assist or enhance the main treatment.

examples.text: Radiotherapy is frequently employed as an <w>adjuvant</w> following radical surgical resection.
The clinician prescribed the secondary medication purely as an <w>adjuvant</w> to manage residual symptoms.

senses.sense_definition: An ingredient added to a pharmaceutical product to aid or modify the effect of the primary active substance.

examples.text: The pharmacist included an <w>adjuvant</w> to improve absorption of the primary medicinal agent.
Testing verified that the chemical <w>adjuvant</w> prolonged the overall duration of the drug.

senses.sense_definition: Something that enhances the effectiveness of a pesticide, or a person or thing that provides general assistance.

examples.text: Farmers mix a chemical <w>adjuvant</w> with the spray to ensure better adhesion to plant foliage.
The technical advisor acted as an <w>adjuvant</w> to the lead engineering team during the project.
